spans.s:
(उ,) खनु r. 1st cl. (खनति-ते)
1 To dig or delve.
2 To hurt.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Tearing, dividing.
2 Digging, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A rat.
2 A housebreaker.
3 A miner.
E.
खन to dig, affix ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्)
Digging.
E.
खन, and शतृ aff.

f. (-निः or -नी)
A mine, especially of precious stones; when used in composition with आकर, more commonly a mine of the precious metals.
E.
खन to dig, इन् affix, and ङीष् optionally added.

mf. (-निः-नी)
A mine.
E.
खन to dig, इञ् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what digs or delves, a digger, a ditcher, &c.
E.
खन to dig, तृच् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A spade or hoe.
E.
खन to dig, इत्रच् aff.

n. (-कं)
An opening or hole in a wall, a breach.
E.
खन to dig, affix ठञ्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A housebreaker.
E.
खन to dig, इलच् affix, deriv. irr.; this is sometimes read खानिन.

m. (-कः)
A cocoanut.
E.
खान rending, and उदक water.
